## Deploy readiness board (R100, informational)

This check is informational on pull requests during the pre-launch
burn-down. It gates only the codebase-invariant sections (stub values
and prod-switch coherence). The environment-dependent sections (wiring,
env discovery, operator keys) are surfaced below but do not block the
PR because the runner carries no production secrets. The prod-deploy
gate (deploy-readiness-gate) enforces every section under strict mode.


READY FOR AUDIT (operator 116) — growth-project-backend#683 @ e2af8ca1fe872ca3c319b52b3ac3b8fca17de7bd

Piece F3 of the fees split of #627 (6 pieces: #681 -> #682 -> #683 -> #684 -> #685 -> #686). Base `agent115/fee-split-2-transfer-orchestrator`. T4 (max-tier rule).
Checks at this head (latest run per check, 13 checks): all green except **build-and-test**, which is red by design: F2 swaps the transfer orchestrator under main's purchase-split handler; main's purchase-split, webhook fee-split and checkout specs stay red until F4 (#684) carries their updated versions. Lenses verify the red check fails only for that reason.
Land rule: Land as one (MERGE_DEPENDENCY_GUIDE rule 11): after dual APPROVE on every piece, merge F6 into F5 ... F2 into F1, confirm F1's tree equals the audited F6 head, merge F1 into main with all required checks green, deploy together with mobile #321. F1 must not land alone.

SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator 116, MODEL_ROUTING 8.2) — growth-project-backend#683 @ e2af8ca1fe872ca3c319b52b3ac3b8fca17de7bd
- Lines: 2895 changed (source 2309 / tests 586 / migrations 0 / docs 0; excluded 0); 3 files. Under the 3,000 hard limit.
- Seams (largest areas): `src/connect/fees` 2309, `test/s-fee-charge-settlement.spec.ts` 586.
- Coupling: code piece with its own tests; the piece boundaries, dependency direction (no piece imports a later piece) and per-piece tests are stated in the PR body.
- Decision: KEEP. This is already one logical piece of the owner-ordered split of #627. Cutting it further would separate code from the tests that prove it, and would add a restack round to every later piece without making any line easier to audit. Fix rounds must keep it under 3,000.
